name: Chikubu Island (Chikubushima)
description: A small sacred island in northern Lake Biwa, home to Hogon-ji Temple and Tsukubusuma Shrine, reached only by Biwako Kisen ferry from Nagahama or Imazu with scenic crossings across the lake.
highlights: Hogon-ji Temple and Tsukubusuma Shrine on a forested lake island
Scenic ferry crossing across northern Lake Biwa

en.name: Chikubu Island (Chikubushima)
en.description: A small sacred island in northern Lake Biwa, home to Hogon-ji Temple and Tsukubusuma Shrine, reached only by Biwako Kisen ferry from Nagahama or Imazu with scenic crossings across the lake.
highlights: Hogon-ji Temple and Tsukubusuma Shrine on a forested lake island
Scenic ferry crossing across northern Lake Biwa
en.notes: FERRY ONLY: no road or rail reaches the island. Biwako Kisen runs the Nagahama route (~35 min each way, adult round trip ¥3,800) and the Imazu route (~25–30 min, ¥3,600), with roughly 85–90-minute landings; schedules vary by season and weather, and an island admission fee applies. The recommendedVisitHours cover time ON the island only — the crossing and any train to the port are transport.
en.reservation: Ferries run on fixed daily schedules that change by season; check the Biwako Kisen timetable before visiting.
en.parking: Use the ferry from Nagahama or Imazu; check the operator's port-access guidance for current parking.
en.openingHours: Visitor hours and closures vary by date; check the official visitor guidance before visiting.

ja.name: 竹生島
ja.description: 琵琶湖北部に浮かぶ小島。宝厳寺と竹生島神社があり、長浜港または今津港から琵琶湖汽船の遊覧船で渡ります。
highlights: 琵琶湖を横断する遊覧船の旅
ja.notes: 島へはフェリーでのみアクセスできます（道路・鉄道なし）。琵琶湖汽船が長浜航路（片道約35分、大人往復3,800円）と今津航路（約25〜30分、3,600円）を運航し、上陸時間は約85〜90分。時期・天候によりダイヤが変わり、入島料が別途必要です。滞在時間は島内の体験時間のみで、航路や港までの移動は含みません。
ja.reservation: 予約・入場条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.parking: 可能な限り公共交通機関をご利用ください。駐車場の条件は公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.openingHours: 開館時間・休館日は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
